overview: White pushes the a-pawn to a6 against Black's pawn centre on d5, e5 and f5, offering the pawn with 4.a6. Black can take with ...bxa6 and hold a pawn or ignore the pawn and develop. White tries to use the open a-file and the weakened queenside, but the pawn push is slow. Read from the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Open the a-file with axb7 or Bxa6
Develop with Nf3 and Bb5 or Bd3

typical_structures.structure: Black centre pawns on d5, e5 and f5 against White's a6 spearhead

character.notes: A pawn offered for activity, but few forcing lines.

gambit.notes: Black can take on a6 and keep the pawn.

soundness.notes: Black's centre is stronger and White's compensation is thin.

structure.notes: The centre pawns are not locked or traded early.

level.notes: Dubious and rare, so not Beginner.
